decisions.reason: The mitred lever family adds a distinct design option to the coordinated range, and the tooling is already paid for, so it is likely to stay despite Product A's withdrawal.
A multifunctional lever supports the firm's barrier-free and system-solution direction, which argues for keeping it.
Premium lever lines that planners specify usually have long lifecycles, and there is no sign of underperformance, though the earlier drop of A shows some pruning risk.
The award-winning FSB 1289 collection has its own page and acts as a flagship, so withdrawal is very unlikely.
The light patinated bronze finish uses in-house finishing expertise across many models at low maintenance cost and fits the sustainable-materials story.
